_comment: On-demand only, not scheduled - checking for updates is safe to automate, but applying them unattended on a machine Bret depends on (Pyramid, Kali Pi) is not something to schedule blind. Dispatch by voice/CLI when wanted.
dispatch_command: openclaw agent --agent __AGENT_ID__ --message "check for and report available updates"
optional_weekly_check_only: openclaw automations add --cron "0 8 * * 1" --message "check for available updates and report - do not apply" --agent __AGENT_ID__ --session isolated
